name: Sandy (United States)
description: Dark blue sky with a white star over green mountains outlined in white, for the Wasatch Range above the city.
history: Sandy is a city in the Salt Lake City metropolitan area, located in Salt Lake County, Utah. The flag was adopted in 2023 (designed by Marcus Xavier, chosen in Mayor Monica Zoltanski's Flag Design Initiative from 33 submissions and a public vote, and unveiled at the Heritage Festival on 16 September 2023, according to Flags of the World).
